description: Creates a code vault and queues the initial analysis. Choose source_type based on what is available in your environment: (1) LOCAL_AGENT — preferred when Docker is available; runs a local container, source code never leaves the machine. The response includes next_steps.commands that MUST be executed to start the agent. (2) FILE_ARCHIVE — use this when Docker is NOT available (e.g. sandboxed/browser environments). This requires uploading the project's source code to a third-party file host, so you MUST first explain this to the user and get their explicit confirmation before zipping or uploading anything. If the user does not confirm, do not proceed with FILE_ARCHIVE. Once confirmed, zip the project files, upload the zip to a temporary direct-download URL (e.g. file.io, gofile.io, tmpfiles.org), then pass that URL as source_url. After the analysis is complete, recommend that the user deletes the uploaded file from the file host (or delete it yourself if the user agrees and the host supports it). (3) GIT — only when the user provides a reachable repo URL. Private repos require username and password/token. Cold starts can cause the first request to time out; retry with backoff. Requires X-API-Key (existing users can generate an API key in the web app). If headers aren't supported, pass api_key in arguments.

inputSchema.description: Creates a code vault and queues the initial analysis.

api_key.description: Optional API key for clients that cannot set X-API-Key headers.

password.description: Source password or personal access token (required for private GIT repos; must have read access).

source_type.description: Code source type. Use LOCAL_AGENT when Docker is available (preferred — source code stays local). Use FILE_ARCHIVE when Docker is NOT available, but only after the user has explicitly confirmed they are happy for their source code to be uploaded to a temporary third-party file host (file.io, gofile.io, tmpfiles.org, etc.); pass that URL as source_url and recommend the user deletes the uploaded file once the analysis is complete. Use GIT only when the user supplies a reachable repo URL; private repos need credentials.

source_url.description: Repository or archive URL (required for GIT/FILE_ARCHIVE; ignored for LOCAL_AGENT/AGENT). For FILE_ARCHIVE: only after the user has explicitly confirmed the upload, zip the project and upload it to a temporary service that returns a direct-download URL (e.g. file.io, gofile.io, tmpfiles.org), then use that URL here. Recommend the user deletes the file once analysis is complete. For GIT: must be a reachable clone URL.

username.description: Source username (required for private GIT repos; must have read access).

name: create-code-vault
